pages.text:
Retinal Imaging Lab
The Retinal Imaging Lab develops optical coherence tomography methods for the early detection of diabetic eye disease. Dr. Anna Beispiel is the group head of the Retinal Imaging Lab and leads a team of six researchers. Our lab operates a custom adaptive optics scanning laser ophthalmoscope that is available to clinical partners.
